description: This tilted bar chart illustrates the average performance of various methods or models. The horizontal axis displays the categories, which are ordered from left to right in ascending order of their corresponding values. The category labels are "[...]d" (partially obscured), "Self-RAG", "FactTune", "CInGS (w/)", and "CInGS". The vertical axis is labeled "Average Performance" and uses a linear scale with visible numeric tick marks ranging from 10 to 60 at regular intervals of 10, accompanied by dashed horizontal grid lines. The chart contains five individual vertical bars, each uniquely colored. The shortest bar, corresponding to the partially obscured label ending in "d", is orange and has an approximate value of 52. The "Self-RAG" bar is a muted khaki color with a value of roughly 58, followed by the light green "FactTune" bar at approximately 60. The "CInGS (w/)" bar is steel blue and reaches a value of about 65. The tallest bar, labeled "CInGS", is colored a bright, solid blue—visually distinguishing it from the more muted tones of the other bars—and extends beyond the top visible grid line to an estimated value near 70. The bars are sorted in a strictly ascending sequence based on their height.
